QF.id: AIFM AIFs in India and Suitability_15

question.text: Which of the following lists contains ONLY Category I AIF sub-categories under SEBI (AIF) Regulations, 2012, with no Category II or Category III items (note: the list need not be exhaustive of all Category I sub-categories)?

answer.text: Venture Capital Fund, SME Fund, Private Equity Fund, Infrastructure Fund
Venture Capital Fund, SME Fund, Angel Fund, Infrastructure Fund, Social Impact Fund, Special Situations Fund
Venture Capital Fund, Hedge Fund, Private Equity Fund, Debt Fund
Angel Fund, Hedge Fund, Special Situations Fund, Corporate Debt Market Development Fund

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the AIF Managers workbook (pp. 85-87 and p. 487), Category I AIF sub-categories include Venture Capital Funds, SME Funds, Angel Funds, Infrastructure Funds, Social Impact Funds, Special Situations Funds and the Corporate Debt Market Development Fund (CDMDF). Private Equity Funds and Debt Funds fall under Category II, while Hedge Funds fall under Category III. The Trap: Option A wrongly includes Private Equity Fund, which is Category II. Option C mixes Private Equity Fund and Debt Fund (Category II) and Hedge Fund (Category III) into a purported Category I list. Option D wrongly includes Hedge Fund, which is Category III, even though it correctly includes Angel Fund, Special Situations Fund and CDMDF. Note: The keyed list is a subset of Category I sub-categories and does not include the Corporate Debt Market Development Fund (CDMDF), which is also a Category I sub-category per pp. 85-87 and p. 487; the stem therefore asks for a non-exhaustive but pure Category I list.
